## What lands

- **Shared place box on `/map/`** — the static GET form wraps the same
  `<sig-typeahead>` over the same release-pinned shards (`scope="kind:place"`;
  T2 rule honoured: the element registers via the island's content-hashed
  bundle, no `/_kit/` src). The island's own box prevents the element's
  navigation via the new cancelable `sig-typeahead-select` event and
  applies the choice itself.
- **Registry + cities shards (OD-09 = a, Natural Earth — never a hosted
  geocoder)** — the committed `sig.place-cities/1` populated-places
  fixture joins the catalog as `kind=place` (40 non-US cities incl.
  Canberra — "Canberra → 0" fixed); NE's upstream capture stays
  HG-03-gated (fixture-bypass posture). Entries carry `lat`/`lon` +
  "Made with Natural Earth" attribution; href = the linkable `map/?at=` frame.
- **Coordinates parser** — `web/src/lib/coordinates.ts`: `lat, lon` pairs
  with optional hemisphere letters parse locally and jump; ambiguity,
  range violations and contradictory sign+letter refuse (never a guess).
- **`jurisdiction=` framing vs facet (C-11)** — `jurisdiction=<jkey>` is
  the descendants-inclusive FILTER (chain membership; cells honestly
  cannot slice it below z10 → grey + note) and frames the registry bbox
  only when no `at=` is given. Selection lands the filter state; the chip
  offers "Show this area instead" (framing-only `at=` link) and
  "Filter to this place" converts back — both states distinct + linkable.
  `frame=<jkey>` folds to `at=` through the new jkey→bounds resolver
  (`canonicaliseWorkspaceState`'s owned seam, receipt in `notes`).
- **'My location'** — P37.72's control; D-K1-7 = yes carried verbatim.
- **No-JS path** — the GET form stays complete (`/search/?type=place` +
  A–Z fallback); **no `/map/place/` route ships** (C-24/C-18).
